body:
N-39 PROOF AND FIX, 17 Nov 2026. Built, not walked; the item stays TODO. Fakes only, nothing run on a device. Tests: app/test/data/downloads/download_manager_cancel_test.dart (14: 9 seen red before the fix, 5 characterise what was right; each of 9 mutations of the new code caught). The full table is in the PR body.

THE PREMISE, RE-STATED. The item said the next pump starts a cancelled file again. Proved: (1) the next PUMP never does: it starts only rows that are queued; (2) the cancelled row stayed "downloading" with no task behind it: the pin and the card never ended, the freed place stayed empty, and the next START of the app put the row back in the queue at once (no back-off): the restart is real, but at start; (3) the Cancel button is gone (#107).

EVERY WAY A TASK ENDS AS CANCELED (plugin background_downloader 9.6.4, READ not run):
1 Manager _delete -> transport.cancel (download_manager.dart 258-263): pin removed or grace over. The row is deleted in the same pass; the one acknowledgement (BDPlugin.kt 404-535, base_downloader.dart 525-540) is handled after it and finds no row. No restart.
2 Cancel on the group card of an OLDER build (Notifications.kt 190-224, 615-619): only for tasks that build handed over and that are unfinished after the upgrade. The ONLY person-reachable path left.
3 reset(group): never called (grep app/lib). No holding queue, no UIDT, no Config.
4 Updates kept while the app was dead (base_downloader.dart 275-297): they raced start()'s rows-without-task loop.
5 A system stop (Wi-Fi lost): TaskRunner.kt 664-702 gives FAILED, never canceled.

FIXED (download_manager.dart): a canceled for a row that says downloading ends the attempt like a failed transfer: failed song "The download was stopped", back-off 5 min x 2^n up to 6 h, Retry at once; a refresh keeps the old copy and deletes its .new file; the place is used at once; start() handles replayed updates BEFORE requeueing rows (resume() completes after they were handed over) and no pass hands out a song until start() has counted the tasks that still run (a replay pump had started 4 more beside 2 running: past the limit of 4); a refresh's .new file is also found from the update's path after a restart. The person sees the existing plain sentence: NO new sentence. Docs: docs/33 PB-F22, audit B-134 (B-135 untouched), CHANGELOG.

WHY N-39 STAYS TODO: its promise is a Stop that keeps the files and waits. A cancel from outside is tried again after the back-off: honest and bounded, not "stays cancelled". That needs a stopped state in the database and a drawn control.

DRAWING NEEDED (Stop; not coded). (a) Where: the download's line in Downloaded (S-16), where Retry stands when songs did not come, while songs are coming; NOT on the S-95 card (Q5; a frozen dated card cannot act). (b) States: Stopping; Stopped with files kept ("12 of 217 are on this phone") with Resume; the result card of a stopped job; songs added later to a stopped list wait for Resume. (c) Does Stop end the server's saving too? Proposed no. (d) Apart from Remove (turn the download off), which deletes at once with no question today (PB-40): a drawn confirmation. (e) A sentence for the reason, replacing "Could not be saved on this phone.".

KNOWN LIMIT (propose an item after N-40): a late acknowledgement of an OLD task (same id enc:server:track) reaching the manager after the song was started again would end the NEW attempt as failed (its completion repairs it). Not expected in a running app (acknowledgement posted before cancel returns). Root fix: a task id per attempt kept in the row (a migration; touches start()'s requeue = N-40's area).

AUDIT FILE: rows B-133 to B-135 stand twice (lines 235-241, from #107's merge): I updated both B-134 rows; please dedupe.
